items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Was Benny Golson there? Yeah. And they chose me to do that... I did whatever they told me, and that was one of the things that they told me, and it was just another job for me to do.

ctx.x: I know, but you haven’t noticed that other people have lost that art? The shadings.
I don’t know of anybody that’s doing that, but I don’t hear Benny Golson’s and Randy – I mean Ernie’s – I don’t hear those things, so I don’t know whether they’re doing that or not.
But did you use that with your colleagues – your bands down in Jamaica? Did you – you taught them about shadings and . . .
